title: Effective Controllable Bias Mitigation for Classification and Retrieval using Gate Adapters

bias_targets.methodology: Training probing classifiers on model embeddings to predict gender (representational fairness), evaluating empirical fairness using the GAP metric in classification tasks, and calculating Normalized Fairness of Retrieval Results (NFaiRR) based on gendered word frequencies in search task outputs.

Training probing classifiers on model embeddings to predict dialect-based race (African American vs. White American) in a hate speech detection dataset, and evaluating empirical fairness using the GAP metric.
Training probing classifiers on model embeddings to predict the author's age group in a tweet mention prediction task.
